name: Folketing
notes: 179 seats (175 for Denmark proper, 2 for Greenland, 2 for the Faroe Islands). Who sits and their party are from the Folketing's open data (oda.ft.dk), the members of each party group in session 2026-27: 179 named, the rest shown as Vacant (a substitute not yet entered, or a seat open). Members on leave are left out (a substitute serves). Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
